title: Hand Crossbow +1

sources.title: Piercing Shot
markers: | description = Deal regular damage and possibly inflict {{SmCond|Gaping Wounds}} which cause extra damage on attacks.

sources.title: Mobile Shot
markers: | description = After using {{SmSAI|Dash}} or {{SmSAI|Disengage}} this turn, you can make a ranged attack as a bonus action.

summary: One-handed martial hand crossbow dealing 1d6 + 1 Piercing, with 50 ft normal range.

fields.Weapon profile: 1d6 + 1 Piercing plus Dexterity modifier. Martial, one-handed, Light, ammunition, loading and dippable. Normal range 50 ft.
fields.Piercing Shot: With proficiency, Action once per Short Rest. Make a ranged weapon attack. On hit, the target makes a Constitution save against weapon-action DC +2. Failure causes Gaping Wounds for 2 turns, or 4 with Crossbow Expert: Wounding. Undead and Constructs are immune to this rider.
fields.Mobile Shot: With proficiency, Bonus Action once per Short Rest after Dash or Disengage on this turn. Make a 50 ft ranged weapon attack for 1d6 Piercing plus Dexterity modifier. The pinned source reports dashing multiple times on the same turn prevents use.
fields.Enchantment: +1 to attack and damage rolls, included in listed damage.
fields.Base value: 65 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
